notes: found_line: dbt's 'Found ...' counts in a fixed order (dbt prints the same parts in a varying order).
nodes = models, seeds, snapshots, analyses, data tests and unit tests, sorted by unique_id; `ls` = the line dbt ls prints (default output), `search_name` = dbt ls --output name.
dbt ls prints selected nodes in sorted(unique_id) order; analyses are listed only with --resource-type analysis/all.
edges = dbt's selection graph (parent, child); test_edges = extra (test, node) edges that `dbt build` adds before selecting (Linker.add_test_edges).
config: keys with null/empty values removed (materialized, enabled, tags always kept); `prod` = values that differ with --target prod.

selectors_yml:
selectors:
  - name: staging_only
    description: Only the staging layer (models and their tests).
    definition:
      method: path
      value: models/staging

  - name: nightly
    description: The nightly job - every finance or marketing mart, with all its parents.
    definition:
      union:
        - method: tag
          value: finance
          parents: true
        - method: tag
          value: marketing
          parents: true

  - name: finance_marts
    description: Finance models that live in the marts folder (intersection).
    definition:
      intersection:
        - method: tag
          value: finance
        - method: path
          value: models/marts

  - name: no_python
    description: Everything except the Python model.
    definition:
      union:
        - method: fqn
          value: "*"
        - exclude:
            - method: fqn
              value: customer_segments

  - name: dev_default
    description: TEMPORARY demo - used when no selection is given, in dev only.
    default: "{{ target.name == 'dev' }}"
    definition: 'tag:finance'
